indexPolicy.rule: Candidate indexes may be tested in the sandbox database, but accepted indexes must be promoted into db/ddl. Do not treat sandbox-created indexes as adopted schema.

nextActions: Use the execution plan and timing evidence to decide the next SQL or index experiment.
Candidate indexes may be applied to the sandbox database for measurement only.
Accepted indexes must be written to db/ddl before they become product schema.
After applying a candidate index, run ANALYZE and record another measurement.
